parameters.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
prev AS (
  SELECT status FROM servers WHERE name = (SELECT j->>'server' FROM d)
),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO servers (name, last_seen, status)
  SELECT j->>'server', now(), 'up' FROM d
  ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET last_seen = now(), status = 'up'
  RETURNING name
),
p AS (
  INSERT INTO payloads (server, type, sent_at, max_level, needs_ai, body)
  SELECT j->>'server', j->>'type', (j->>'sent_at')::timestamptz,
         j->>'max_level', (j->>'needs_ai')::boolean, j->'payload'
  FROM d
  RETURNING id
),
e AS (
  INSERT INTO events (server, payload_type, source, level, message, count,
                      first_seen, last_seen, already_alerted)
  SELECT d.j->>'server', d.j->>'type', x->>'source', x->>'level', x->>'message',
         COALESCE((x->>'count')::int, 1),
         (x->>'first_seen')::timestamptz, (x->>'last_seen')::timestamptz,
         COALESCE((x->>'already_alerted')::boolean, false)
  FROM d, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(d.j->'payload'->'events', '[]'::jsonb)) x
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT status FROM prev)  AS prev_status,
       (SELECT id FROM p)         AS payload_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM e)   AS events_stored,
       (SELECT j->>'server' FROM d) AS server;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM incidents
    WHERE signature = $1 AND created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes')::int AS recent_dupes,

  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT server, source, level, message, count,
            to_char(last_seen AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur', 'HH24:MI:SS') AS at
     FROM events
     WHERE received_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND level IN ('error', 'critical')
     ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 40) t) AS recent_events,

  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(s), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT name, status,
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last_seen)::int AS seconds_since_last_report
     FROM servers ORDER BY name) s) AS servers;

INSERT INTO incidents (signature, severity, title, root_cause, affected_servers,
                       fix_steps, confidence, alerted, ai_raw)
SELECT j->>'signature', j->>'severity', j->>'title', j->>'root_cause',
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j->'affected_servers', '[]'::jsonb))),
       j->'fix_steps', (j->>'confidence')::numeric, (j->>'should_alert')::boolean, j->'ai_raw'
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j) d
RETURNING id;
